harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a Python2 inventory web application (systemd service inventory-app.service) on node2 and node3, each listening on 0.0.0.0:8080 and returning JSON inventory data plus its own hostname. Configured node1 with a Python2 round-robin reverse-proxy load balancer (systemd service inventory-lb.service) listening on port 80, forwarding to both backends. Firewalld ports opened (8080 on node2/node3, 80 on node1). Verified round-robin distribution across both backends. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, then node1 (LB last), confirming boot_id changes and full service/data recovery (and end-to-end LB round-robin) after every restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed OS/tooling on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7.9, no yum repos, Python2.7 only, sudo available)
Wrote /opt/inventory-app/inventory_app.py (Python2 BaseHTTPServer) on node2 and node3 serving /,/inventory,/health with JSON inventory + backend hostname
Created and enabled inventory-app.service (systemd) on node2 and node3, bound to 0.0.0.0:8080
Opened firewalld port 8080/tcp on node2 and node3
Verified backend health from node1 via each node's private IP
Wrote /opt/inventory-lb/lb.py on node1: Python2 round-robin reverse proxy forwarding to node2:8080 and node3:8080 with failover on error
Created and enabled inventory-lb.service (systemd) on node1, bound to 0.0.0.0:80
Opened firewalld port 80/tcp on node1
Verified round-robin load balancing via repeated curl calls to node1 port 80 (both /health and /inventory), confirming alternating backend responses
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime/service-health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until exec available, verified new boot_id and inventory-app.service/health recovery, then confirmed LB on node1 still routes correctly
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until exec available, verified new boot_id and inventory-app.service/health recovery, then confirmed LB on node1 still routes correctly
Restarted node1 (LB) last via systemctl reboot, polled until exec available, verified new boot_id and inventory-lb.service recovery
Ran final end-to-end verification: 6 sequential requests to node1:80/inventory via NODE_IP alternated cleanly between node2 and node3 backends

evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node2 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory_app.py written, systemd service enabled/active, curl to 127.0.0.1:8080/health returns backend=node2

evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node3 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory_app.py written, systemd service enabled/active, curl to 127.0.0.1:8080/health returns backend=node3

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances HTTP requests across both backends on port 80
evidence.summary: lb.py round-robin proxy written and running as systemd service on port 80; repeated curl calls to node1 alternate between node2 and node3 backend responses on both /health and /inventory

evidence.requirement: Firewall configuration allows required traffic
evidence.summary: firewalld opened 8080/tcp on node2 and node3, 80/tcp on node1, confirmed via firewall-cmd --list-ports

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 9ed9e820... captured, inventory-app.service active

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; after polling, exec available again with new boot_id 5936d338... (changed from 9ed9e820...)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: recovered service/data and cluster function
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service active and /health returns backend=node2 post-reboot; LB on node1 confirmed routing to node2 again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id a8e7c48c... captured, inventory-app.service active

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; after polling, exec available again with new boot_id 332c2973... (changed from a8e7c48c...)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: recovered service/data and cluster function
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service active and /health returns backend=node3 post-reboot; LB on node1 confirmed routing to both node2 and node3 again

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 151c4aa9... captured, inventory-lb.service active, port 80 open

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement and boot identity change
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; after polling, exec available again with new boot_id 23e5428c... (changed from 151c4aa9...)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered load-balancer function
evidence.summary: inventory-lb.service active post-reboot with port 80 open; final 6-request end-to-end test shows clean round-robin alternation between node2 and node3 through node1:80
